title: Auto Share
description: Automatically shares resource packs over LAN with no manual installation
body:
## Auto Share Auto Share is a Minecraft mod that allows the owner of a local network world to automatically distribute resource packs to everyone else, eliminating the need for each player to download and install them manually. ## Usage * One player (the host) specifies a direct link to the ZIP archive containing the resource pack in the mod's config. * As soon as other players connect to the local world, the mod offers to automatically download the resource packs in the background and applies them. * No manual downloads, folder transfers, or game restarts—everything happens on the fly. ## Information for world owners * The link must be to a ZIP file. On most websites, simply copying the link to the download button is sufficient. Examples of obtaining links for Modrinth and CurseForge.
Modrinth ![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4e0bc0df18b2e8a721974edf9a092ce29d81bca.gif)
CurseForge ![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8323c41694201fe3be9fe199bf2e2117a238e62d.gif)
* The links must then be specified in the mod's configuration. * You can also specify whether resource packs are required. In this case, the player will not be able to enter the world without downloading the resource pack. ## Support Want to help create and develop my projects?
